breakdown.summary: A 25.6 s square UI-motion piece by a motion designer: a Spotify logo animates into an AI search bar, 'Get me Nemzzz top 3' is typed, a track list appears and a cursor plays 'DILEMMA' - which drops you into a 3D kinetic-typography lyric video of the song (white words on curved lines, a virtual camera whipping from line to line over blurred backgrounds that match the words: demon, angel eyes, hypnotised). It returns to the UI, clicks 'ESCAPE', and leaves through a stepped blinds/grid wipe. Everything is made in post; there is no live footage apart from still/blurred background plates.
breakdown.hook: f0-89 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:29): no cuts - a logo build on black (f4-10), the logo shrinks and its badge + green glow come up exactly on the bass drop f30 (00:00:01:00), then a colour-cycling morph of the logo into a search bar (f40-73) that slams down on a beat at f73. It stops the scroll because the brand is recognisable at once and every beat of the first 3 s moves something; the first words on screen, 'Yo!!', arrive at f53.
structure: f0-86 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:26) intro: Spotify logo build, drop, morph into the search bar
f87-201 (00:00:02:27-00:00:06:21) the app: typed prompt 'Get me Nemzzz top 3', the 3 tracks rise in, hover + click on DILEMMA
f201-574 (00:00:06:21-00:00:19:04) payoff: the lyric video - kinetic typography over 4 background plates (dark blurred photo, demon silhouette f422, eye close-up f451, hypnotic tunnel f493)
f575-623 (00:00:19:05-00:00:20:23) back in the app: click on ESCAPE (green glow f604-612)
f624-768 (00:00:20:24-00:00:25:18) outro: stepped blinds + grid wipe to black (black from f717)
breakdown.captions: No speech captions. The lyrics ARE the captions: a clean bold sans (rounded geometric, like Gilroy/Circular), white with a soft dark drop shadow, set as 2-3 words per line on a curved 3D surface; the active line is large and sharp, the next one sits below small, dark and defocused and comes into focus when the camera arrives. Left-aligned, upper half of the square frame.
text_graphics: Spotify-like dark UI in its real style: rounded pill search bar with a green search icon, track cards with cover art, title, explicit 'E' badge, artists, duration and a player row (shuffle, prev, pause, next, repeat, progress bar)
typing with a green 'tail' on the newest letters (E006)
a hand cursor with heavy motion blur that drives the story (hover, click, pull-down)
small nods matching the words: a green Sims plumbob next to 'dime' (f209-232)
breakdown.broll: Backgrounds instead of b-roll: each is a still, heavily blurred plate that changes when the lyric changes topic - a dark red/black photo, a horned demon silhouette in orange haze (on 'Demon', f422), a woman's eye close-up (on 'angel eyes', f451) and an op-art hypnotic tunnel (on 'I'm hypnotised', f493). Every swap is hidden: under a sparks burst, under a whip + 1-4 inverted frames, or a dive into the eye.
breakdown.sound: The song (BPM about 134, beat every 13.4 frames) from the first frame; one big bass drop at f30 (00:00:01:00). A spoken line is heard at f4 ('Yo, I've been ghosting you...'). Visual hits follow the vocal words more than the beat grid: the inverts land on 'knife' (f350) and 'Tryna get' (f389), between beats; the drop, the pill slam (f73), the icon going green (f101) and the sparks (f421) are on beats.
breakdown.cta: None on screen - the creator's name 'illdari' appears inside the green pill at f74-80 (00:00:02:14-00:00:02:20) as a signature.
transitions: logo -> search bar: a morph in one 3D space with a full hue cycle (E003)
UI -> lyrics: the lyric scene slides down over the UI as if pulled by the cursor (E009)
background swaps hidden under a sparks burst (E025), under a whip + 4 inverted frames (E028), and a dive into the eye with inverted frames (E031/E032)
lyrics -> UI: accelerating zoom-out with zoom blur into a bent UI that straightens (E038)
outro: stepped horizontal blinds, then a grid of tiles, then black (E039/E040)
breakdown.camera: No real camera. A virtual 3D camera flies over curved text lines: every line change is a 3-7 frame whip or tilt with strong motion blur and a soft settle (E010-E035), sometimes a slow drift or a small push. Only the text layer moves; the background plates stay still in 2D, which is what keeps it readable.
breakdown.grade: Dark, low-key, low contrast with crushed blacks (measured: brightness 10%, blacks 0.8%, whites 36%). Each part owns one colour: Spotify green f0-86, cool grey-blue UI, dark red/black lyrics, warm orange demon, warm skin eye, black-and-white tunnel. The 'warm' reading of f422-488 is the backgrounds' own colour, not a grade. The inverted frames read as pale cyan.
breakdown.rhythm: Measured 32.8 cuts/min but almost none are real cuts - they are background swaps and graphic changes; 0% of plain cuts on the beat because there is only one plain cut (f422). The real rhythm is the camera: a new lyric line every 30-50 frames, each reached with a 3-7 frame whip. Music hits: drop f30, pill slam f73, icon f101, sparks f421.
rebuild_tips: Build it in Fusion (or as a HyperFrames graphic): one 3D scene per part - Text3D / bent ImagePlane3D lines + Camera3D + Renderer3D with Motion Blur on; keep the background plate 2D behind it
Lyrics: 2-3 words per line, white bold sans with a soft shadow; next line below, darker and blurred (Blur 15 -> 0 over 8 frames when the camera arrives); whip to each line in 3-7 frames, ease out
Swap the background whenever the lyric changes topic, and hide each swap: a whip + 1-4 inverted frames (Invert adjustment), a screen-blended sparks clip, or a scale-through into an element

For the app part, recreate the UI as layers (bar, cards, cursor PNG): rise-ins with ease-out + motion blur, Text+ Write On for typing with a green trailing copy, a Fast Noise threshold mask for the liquid dissolve
Land the brand moment on the drop (here f30) and keep the intro free of cuts - everything moves on the beats instead
End on a stepped graphic wipe (step keyframes, no easing) to black, and leave ~1.5 s of black for the loop
